facts.fact: 别跟网球选手约会：love 在网球里是“零分”，所以“对他们来说爱什么都不是”
facts.anchor: Why should you never date a tennis player? Because to them, love means nothing.

facts.fact: 姻亲与亡命徒的区别：outlaws（通缉犯）是被人想要的（wanted）；in-laws 只是“在内”的亲戚
facts.anchor: What’s the difference between in-laws and outlaws? Outlaws are wanted.

facts.fact: 不该和公路养护部门的官员交往：All the signs were there——公路标志／一切迹象早就明摆着
facts.anchor: I should never have gone out with the officer from the motorway maintenance department. All the signs were there.

facts.fact: 女友要我像公主一样待她，我便安排她嫁给陌生人，以巩固王国与奥地利的联盟——把“公主待遇”按字面执行成王朝联姻
facts.anchor: My girlfriend wanted me to treat her like a princess, so I arranged to have her married to a stranger in order to strengthen my kingdom’s alliance with Austria.

facts.fact: 妻子让我别再学火烈鸟，最后我只好 put my foot down——下定论／把脚放下来（火烈鸟单脚站立）
facts.anchor: My wife kept asking me to stop impersonating a flamingo. Eventually I had to put my foot down.

facts.fact: 妻子让我递口红，我误递了固体胶，她至今不跟我说话——still isn’t talking to me 与“嘴唇被粘住”双关
facts.anchor: The other day, my wife asked me to pass her lipstick, but I accidentally passed her a glue stick. She still isn’t talking to me.

facts.fact: 我把妻子的香料架标签全换了：现在还没事，但 that thyme is cumin——thyme（百里香）谐音 time、cumin（孜然）谐音 coming，“时候快到了”
facts.anchor: I switched all the labels on my wife’s spice rack. I’m not in trouble yet, but that thyme is cumin.

facts.fact: 邋遢孩子骑自行车与体面孩子骑三轮车的区别：Attire（穿着）——谐音 a tyre（一个轮胎，三轮车与两轮之差）
facts.anchor: What’s the difference between a scruffy kid on a bicycle and well-dressed kid on a tricycle? Attire.

facts.fact: 我有一把折叠梯（stepladder），却从没见过我的亲生梯子——step- 被当成继父母式前缀（stepfather／stepmother）
facts.anchor: I have a stepladder. I never met my real ladder.

facts.fact: 妈妈说我没出息，因为我太拖拉；我说“你就等着吧……”——procrastinate 的现世报
facts.anchor: My mum said I’d never amount to anything because I procrastinate too much. I told her, ‘Just you wait …’
